patch.value: Extend measured coverage to every executable TypeScript script and statement dimension

The 2026-09-28 release gate reports 100% lines, branches, and functions over only index.ts and scripts/docstring-gate.ts. This repository has eight scripts/*.ts files plus index.ts; statement coverage is not measured by the Node gate. The current 100% receipt therefore cannot support the requested all-source 100/100/100/100 claim. Package-specific gate configuration and tests must measure every executable source file without exclusions or artificial counters.
Fail closed if any executable TypeScript file is missing from the coverage report; Report and enforce 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines for all executable source
Run npm run coverage; observe coverage-gate: 2 source files reported and three dimensions, then compare with scripts/*.ts and index.ts.
Every executable TypeScript source and all four coverage dimensions are measured at 100%, with a regression test that fails if a source file is omitted.
2 of 9 source files reported and statement coverage absent.
